scope: Local preview of 65 audited Raven spell icons; 7 spells retain their existing Game-icons.net fallback.
license_status: The inspected local pack notes identify the creator but contain no explicit license grant. No MIT, CC0, or CC BY license is assigned to these Raven images by this project. Publication rights have not been verified in this local-only integration.
palette_credit: Resurrect 64 by Kerrie Lake, as credited in the included pack palette notes.
mapping_notes: Visually checked Clockwork Raven skill packs 05,07,08,09,22,29,36, plus specific utility crops supplied and visually verified by root from pack12,27 and Pets/Animals. Conservative semantic proposal, not official spell names. Missing means no sufficiently clear verified candidate in inspected packs, not proof of absence in entire assets library. Color variants do not count as new motifs.
